title: Friend’s Motivation
paragraphs: “Understood. So, what should we do?”
“Filolials are monsters, right? Are we planning to take the Filolials from the castle?”
“The Filolials at the castle are fine, but I’ll go buy them.”

I have no intention of discriminating against the Filolial queens, but I still want to secure Yuki-chan and the others as soon as possible. In terms of immediate combat strength, it’s not a bad idea, but the Filolials at the castle also have their own lives and duties. Taking away Filolials who already have masters other than me would weigh on my conscience.
“I see…”
“No worries. I have a reliable Filolial breeder I’ve been working with for a while, so I’ll buy from them again.”
I looked toward the Queen.
“With the Queen here, we have enough funds, so I’d like to buy in bulk. I’m thinking of purchasing 100 of them.”
Father and the others were dumbfounded. What’s wrong? During the previous loop, I raised 500 of them.
“Mother… this looks fun. It’s the establishment of a Filolial army.”
As expected of Fiancée. She understands the magnificence of Filolial queens.
“Melty, calm down.”
“Yes…”
Fiancée is asserting herself. She’s being quite reserved, though.
“Well, wouldn’t it be better to start with a smaller number? You won’t be able to manage that many.”
“Really? Father seemed to handle it easily last time.”
“We’re still low level. We need to train ourselves first.”
“About the financial assistance… it’s not impossible, but 100 might be too many. It could cause trouble for the supplier.”

Well, that’s true. If we raise them all at once, there’s a risk that management will become insufficient. Cal Mira Island was close to Melromarc, so we had some flexibility, and the Nosferatu Great Forest was under Faubrey’s territory. But now, there’s no infrastructure to support a large number of raised Filolials. Ren, Itsuki, and Father all want to prioritize strengthening themselves first, so I reluctantly agreed.
“So, Motoyasu-kun. Filolials are fine, but what about human personnel?”
“The soldiers of Melromarc are hardly trustworthy. I think it’s best to gather and raise people from the village where the older sister was.”
“Wait, you mean children from Raphtalia-chan and Rifana-chan’s hometown?”

Father glanced at the older sister and her friend. The older sister had that creepy, forced smile on her face but seemed unwilling to agree. On the other hand, her friend clenched her fists, showing a readiness to agree enthusiastically.
“If possible, I’d like to secure the older sister’s older sister as well.”
“Raphtalia-chan’s older sister?”
I nodded. The older sister’s older sister is a very reliable person.
“That’s right.”
“Raphtalia-chan is an only child, so… um, do you mean Sadeena-oneechan?”
The older sister’s friend tilted her head and answered.
“I believe that was her name. She’s a heavy drinker and very strong. She gets unnaturally close with Father.”
“Hmm… I wonder what kind of person she is. Maybe she’s easygoing?”
“She’s a very kind person. Right, Raphtalia-chan?”
“Y-Yeah!”
The older sister nodded in response.
“By the way, she’s skilled at using lightning magic and specializes in electrocuting her enemies.”
“She sounds like someone I’d be both curious and scared to meet.”
“So, Motoyasu-kun, do you know where this Sadeena person is?”
“I forgot to ask.”
Father nearly stumbled at my response. What a comedian.
“You don’t know?”
“I only met the older sister’s older sister in the previous loop.”
I explained how the older sister’s older sister had joined us in Zeltoble. When Father was trying to recruit Panda, for some reason, the older sister’s older sister showed up instead.
“So, in other words, Naofumi was trying to recruit Panda, but ended up attracting that woman?”
“Exactly! She was all over Father, completely playful.”
“Hmm… then I guess we’ll have to look for her at that tavern in Zeltoble tonight?”
We’ll be recreating the situation. The problem is that since the timing is different, we don’t know what will happen.
“Anyone else?”
“Are those the only ones who ended up as slaves?”
“Of course not. If it’s just yesterday or today, I think we could find Keel if we search.”
“You’ve even met Keel-kun?”
“Indeed. In the loop before the last one, I ordered him from the slave trader and they brought him in.”
Father and the others exchanged slightly uneasy glances.
“Well, since Raphtalia-chan and the others were treated as slaves, I can kind of understand… But did I really buy slaves?”
“In the first world, you managed the entire village.”
Ah, I remember the reactions that come after this.
“I don’t understand the version of me that Motoyasu-kun has seen!”

“It’s like a conspiracy where no one believes him, and he apparently gets really agitated. Ren even said something like, ‘If anything, Naofumi is more like the village’s slave!’ or something like that.”

I don’t remember the details very well. Then, Father looked at Ren. Ren shook his head, looking offended. In the previous loop, Ren would have quickly averted his gaze. There are still some differences.
“The conversation’s drifting, but how about taking the children from Raphtalia-san and Rifana-san’s village with us as potential allies while also helping restore their hometown?”
“That might not be a bad idea.”
“Still… I think they might have some emotional issues.”
Father shifted his gaze to the older sister. Ren and Itsuki also noticed his intent.
“But… um, please help us! I’ll do my best! Cough!”
The older sister’s friend pleaded with Father. The older sister also bowed her head a beat later.
“It’s not that I won’t let you help. I heard you out earlier. It’s just that we’ll be fighting monsters wherever we go next. I’m worried if the two of you will be okay with that.”
“Eh…”
The older sister’s forced smile wavered slightly. On the other hand, the older sister’s friend looked determined.
“We’ll do our best! Right, Raphtalia-chan? We have to get stronger!”
The older sister seemed hesitant. She was quite different from the older sister I remember. The older sister I know would have been more courageous and shown determination here.
“Having a higher level is better, don’t you think? No matter what you’re doing. Even restoring the village would be easier with strength.”
The older sister once again forced a smile and nodded at her friend’s words. Isn’t she trying to show some determination?
“Raphtalia-chan…”
The older sister’s friend muttered worriedly, watching her.
“Then today, let’s do our best to gather as many people as possible from Raphtalia-chan and Rifana-chan’s village.”
“Yeah. I’m not a fan of gathering people, but if what Motoyasu says is true, it’s not a bad idea.”
“Indeed. Then, I suppose that’s good for today? We can set off for the activation event tomorrow or the day after.”

It looks like the discussion is coming together. Today, we’ll be gathering the village’s slaves, the Filolials, and the older sister’s older sister. We’ll postpone hiring Panda since the employment cost is high. First, we need to raise Father’s level.
“After that, we’ll get stronger while being cautious of reincarnators and transplants.”
“To do that, we should hide the fact that we’re heroes and focus on the event.”
“That sounds pretty difficult.”
“Then let’s arrange for the kingdom’s slave traders. Kitamura-sama, where would be best?”
This is where I use my knowledge of the future to determine which monster merchant to ask.
“Well then—”
I explained to Father what kind of person the monster merchant he usually favored was.
“Understood. I’ll make the arrangements.”
And so, we headed to the monster merchant.
